stories.headline: Portfolio Killers: 10 US stocks that wiped out up to 66% of investors’ wealth in 2026
stories.summary: The Trade Desk has emerged as the biggest loser on this list, with shares plunging 65.75% in 2026, from $37.96 at the end of last year to $13.00. The digital advertising technology company now has a market capitalisation of $6.1 billion.

stories.headline: Govt of Singapore’s India portfolio: 10 stocks rally up to 100% in FY27 so far
stories.summary: In terms of stock performance, around 14 stocks in the portfolio have delivered positive returns so far in FY27, while nearly half have posted negative returns.

ai_insight.why_it_matters: A concentrated portfolio performance where select stocks rally while nearly half post negative returns highlights how institutional foreign capital distribution can diverge sharply across individual counters despite an overall large holding value. This dynamic suggests that aggregate portfolio size does not insulate investors from stock-specific volatility. If market breadth remains narrow, overall portfolio valuations would likely depend heavily on top-performing outliers rather than uniform sector growth.
what_to_watch: Subsequent quarterly shareholding disclosures to track if foreign institutional investors increase or trim stakes in the top-performing versus negative-returning stocks.
Official exchange data on foreign portfolio investor (FPI) net flows into Indian equities to verify broader market participation trends.
ai_insight.evergreen_lesson: A large aggregate portfolio value by institutional investors often masks deep divergence, where a handful of outperforming stocks drive returns while a significant portion of holdings lag.

stories.headline: Demeter's Ashwini Agarwal sees value in largecaps, financial services and consumer stocks; avoids IT and OMCs
stories.summary: Financial services, offline retail and exporters offer significant value pockets in the current market, while policy uncertainty makes oil marketing companies unattractive, according to Ashwini Agarwal of Demeter Advisors.

ai_insight.why_it_matters: When market corrections widen valuation gaps between large-caps and small-caps, analysts often shift preferences toward segments with stronger alignment between earnings growth and price. This top-down view implies that large-caps could offer better risk-adjusted potential if smaller segments face earnings contraction or sustained multiple compression. However, sector-specific risks like policy uncertainty or raw material costs would still dictate individual stock execution regardless of broad asset class preference.
what_to_watch: Upcoming quarterly earnings reports of large-cap financial services and consumer staples companies to verify if actual earnings growth matches projected recovery.
Macroeconomic data on credit quality, liquidity conditions, and raw material price indices to check for margin pressures.
ai_insight.evergreen_lesson: Market corrections often re-price large-caps and small-caps unevenly, creating distinct entry conditions based on historical earnings-to-price gaps rather than broad index movements.

stories.headline: S&P set to change how it classifies US growth and value stocks
stories.summary: S&P Dow Jones Indices is updating its classification of US stocks as growth or value, dropping momentum for growth and adding free cash flow for value, effective December 21, 2026.

ai_insight.why_it_matters: Modifying index methodologies by dropping momentum and adding free cash flow alters how quantitative and passive institutional funds categorize growth and value stocks. This structural shift would likely cause capital reallocation across funds that track S&P growth and value benchmarks once the reconstitution takes effect. If companies lack robust cash generation after capital expenditures, they might be reclassified or dropped from specific factor baskets independently of their revenue growth.
what_to_watch: Preliminary index rebalancing files released ahead of the effective date to observe which specific companies shift between growth and value categories.
Subsequent portfolio adjustments by exchange-traded funds (ETFs) tracking these indices to measure actual capital flows resulting from the rule change.
ai_insight.evergreen_lesson: Index provider methodology changes alter passive capital flows independently of company fundamentals, forcing constituent stocks into new style buckets based on redefined quantitative rules.

stories.headline: Sebi orders Avadhut Sathe, academy to refund Rs 546 crore
stories.summary: The Securities and Exchange Board of India has directed Avadhut Sathe Trading Academy to refund ₹546.18 crore to investors. Avadhut Sathe and his academy provided unregistered investment advisory services under the pretext of education. The regulator found that misleading testimonials were circulated while concealing overall trading losses. A penalty of ₹11.5 crore was imposed on Sathe and the academy for their actions.

ai_insight.why_it_matters: Regulatory enforcement actions against entities masquerading as educators while providing unregistered investment advice highlight compliance risks in retail financial distribution. This intervention establishes that labeling commercial services as educational programs does not exempt providers from statutory registration requirements if specific trading recommendations are made. If compliance checks intensify, digital financial content creators could face stricter scrutiny regarding the boundary between general education and regulated advisory services.
what_to_watch: Compliance disclosures or appeals regarding the execution of the mandated refund and interest deposit within the specified timeline.
Subsequent regulatory circulars or guidelines clarifying operational boundaries for financial influencers and training academies.
ai_insight.evergreen_lesson: Regulators look past contractual labels to examine the substantive nature of financial services, penalizing unregistered advisory models that use selective performance disclosures.

stories.headline: Growth, value stocks set for reshuffle as S&P adopts new rules
stories.summary: S&P Dow Jones Indices will soon change its rules for classifying growth and value shares. The new criteria will incorporate intangible assets, forward earnings, and free cash flow instead of relying on 12-month price momentum. These changes are expected to affect approximately $375 billion of passive funds linked to the index. FTSE Russell is also considering adjustments due to the dominance of technology companies.

stories.headline: Radhakishan Damani portfolio: Top 10 stock holdings of the ace investor
stories.summary: Damani’s other top stock holdings in terms of holding value are United Breweries, TSF Investments, Horizon Industrial Parks, Blue Dart Express and Bhagiradha Chemicals.

stories.headline: Small and midcap indices post worst weekly decline in two years
stories.summary: Mid-cap and small-cap stocks in India have faced major declines, indicating a shift in market sentiment. The Nifty MidCap 150 and Small-cap 250 indices reported their worst weekly falls in two years. Domestic retail investors initially supported these segments by increasing mutual fund contributions. However, concerns over rising oil prices and fiscal deficits are adding to market uncertainties.

ai_insight.why_it_matters: Jab frontliner blue-chips se risk-off sentiment broad markets mein spread hota hai, toh mid aur small-caps mein sharp corrections dekhi jaati hain jaisa ki indices ke worst weekly decline mein dikha. Yeh indicate karta hai ki market ab sirf liquidity par nahi, balki stretched valuations aur near-term earnings delivery par zyada focus kar raha hai, jisse retail mutual fund flows par pressure aa sakta hai.
what_to_watch: Monthly mutual fund inflow aur retail investment data via AMFI disclosures.
FPIs (Foreign Portfolio Investors) ki subsequent net buying ya selling figures.
ai_insight.evergreen_lesson: Broad market corrections yeh dikhate hain ki jab sentiment aur liquidity tight hoti hai, toh smaller segments jinme weaker earnings profile hoti hai sabse zyada vulnerable ho jaate hain.

stories.headline: RBI’s forward dollar sales surge to record $200 billion in August
stories.summary: The Reserve Bank of India recorded a net purchase of $43.26 billion in August's foreign exchange market. This was done to manage significant dollar inflows from the FCNR(B) scheme and overseas borrowings. Despite the net purchase, foreign exchange reserves did not increase due to large forex sell/buy swaps. By August 31, measures attracted over $127 billion, aiding the RBI's operations.

ai_insight.why_it_matters: Jab RBI spot market mein heavy dollar purchases karta hai aur saath hi sell/buy swaps ke zariye reserves balance karta hai, toh net forward dollar sales record high par pahunch jaati hain. Yeh mechanism batata hai ki central bank temporary inflows ko absorb karne ke liye forward book ka upyog karta hai, jisse immediate liquidity manage hoti hai lekin future ke liye contingent liabilities create ho sakti hain.
what_to_watch: RBI ke bimonthly foreign exchange reserve data aur forward book position disclosures.
FCNR(B) scheme aur overseas borrowing inflows ki sustainability data.
ai_insight.evergreen_lesson: Central bank interventions jo spot inflows ko forward swaps ke zariye absorb karte hain, woh immediate volatility toh control karte hain par future forward commitments ko badha dete hain.

stories.headline: Silver hits 11-month low of ₹1.95 lakh as crude stokes inflation fears
stories.summary: On the Multi Commodity Exchange (MCX), silver futures fell ₹6,799 per kg, or 3.4%, to ₹1,92,800 per kg on Friday. Prices have plunged ₹32,955, or more than 14%, over the past 10 sessions. A recent appreciation in the rupee has provided only limited relief against the decline in international prices.

ai_insight.why_it_matters: Jab crude oil prices badhte hain aur inflation fears ke chalte interest rate hikes ki expectation aati hai, toh precious metals jaise silver aur gold par downward pressure aata hai kyunki yeh non-yielding assets hain. Silver par industrial demand (jaise solar-panel manufacturing aur chip-making) ka bhi asar padta hai, jisse price correction deep ho sakti hai. Yeh movement batata hai ki macro commodities global inflation aur interest rate expectations se kitni tightly linked hain.
what_to_watch: US Federal Reserve ke official rate decisions aur macroeconomic inflation prints.
Global industrial demand indicators jaise solar panel manufacturing aur semiconductor output data.
ai_insight.evergreen_lesson: Precious metals ki pricing sirf safe-haven sentiment par depend nahi karti; global interest rate expectations aur industrial demand cycles bhi inke valuation ko drive karte hain.

stories.headline: RBI flags rising inflation risks from West Asia conflict, El Nino despite resilient Indian economy
stories.summary: India's external sector shows resilience due to a narrowing trade gap and comfortable foreign exchange reserves. Inflationary pressures have intensified due to geopolitical tensions and supply-side bottlenecks. The RBI reported an increase in both industry and services indicators, showcasing economic strength. The IMF has revised India's growth projection for 2026-27 to 7% based on resilient domestic demand. Global financial volatility has increased amid global challenges and rising inflation risks.

ai_insight.why_it_matters: While domestic demand and resilient industrial indicators keep economic growth projections robust, external shocks like geopolitical conflicts and El Nino conditions directly threaten consumer price stability. If supply-side bottlenecks persist, headline inflation could remain elevated, which would likely constrain consumer spending power, particularly in rural regions. However, strong foreign exchange reserves and a narrowing trade deficit indicate that India's external sector buffers can absorb global financial volatility without immediate systemic distress.
what_to_watch: Official Consumer Price Index (CPI) releases tracking rural versus urban inflation trends
Subsequent Reserve Bank of India state of the economy reports and foreign exchange reserve data
ai_insight.evergreen_lesson: Macroeconomic resilience in external trade and foreign reserves does not insulate an economy from localized supply-side inflation shocks driven by weather and geopolitics.

stories.headline: RBI governor reiterates listing requirement for top NBFCs as focus intensifies on Tata Sons
stories.summary: India's central bank governor said on Friday non-bank finance companies classified in the upper layer are required to list on the stock market, reiterating the Reserve Bank of India's stance on the listing of Tata Sons without commenting directly on the company.

ai_insight.why_it_matters: The Reserve Bank of India's insistence that upper-layer non-banking financial companies must list on stock exchanges establishes a strict governance framework for systemically important core investment companies. If holding companies of major conglomerates are compelled to list, public market scrutiny over their consolidated assets and internal capital allocations would increase significantly. However, a regulatory mandate alone does not determine the timeline or final structuring of how these large private holding companies will comply.
what_to_watch: Subsequent corporate disclosures and board resolutions from affected large non-banking financial companies regarding listing plans
Official regulatory updates or enforcement actions by the central bank concerning deregistration applications
ai_insight.evergreen_lesson: Regulatory classifications that tie systemic importance to mandatory public listings remove regulatory arbitrage options for large private holding structures.

stories.headline: Sebi proposes automatic approval route for stock exchanges, depositories to ease compliance burden
stories.summary: The proposal seeks to reduce compliance requirements for market infrastructure institutions (MIIs) and improve ease of doing business. SEBI has invited public comments on the proposed framework until November 12.

ai_insight.why_it_matters: SEBI's proposal to introduce an automatic approval route for market infrastructure institutions aims to reduce operational friction and compliance costs for activities tied to core functions. If implemented within specified financial thresholds and governance safeguards, stock exchanges and depositories would be able to deploy funds faster without prior regulatory sign-off. However, a regulatory consultation paper does not constitute an implemented rule, and final compliance requirements will depend on public comments received.
what_to_watch: The final regulatory framework issued by SEBI following the public comment period ending November 12
Adoption of board-approved standard operating procedures and half-yearly reporting mechanisms by stock exchanges and depositories
ai_insight.evergreen_lesson: Streamlining regulatory compliance through automated approval routes shifts the accountability burden from prior administrative clearance to strict internal board governance and post-facto reporting.

stories.headline: RBI does not target any specific Rupee level, focuses on curbing volatility, says Governor Sanjay Malhotra
stories.summary: Reserve Bank of India (RBI) Governor Sanjay Malhotra on Friday said the central bank does not target any specific exchange rate or level for the rupee against the US dollar, stressing that its primary objective is to ensure orderly conditions in the foreign exchange market and prevent excessive volatility.

ai_insight.why_it_matters: Central bank statements distinguishing between price levels and market volatility highlight an operational focus on liquidity management rather than defending arbitrary valuation thresholds. If the central bank refrains from hard pegging, currency fluctuations would reflect underlying macroeconomic flows and risk sentiments rather than administrative fiat. However, this stance implies that importers and exporters must factor in higher FX volatility into their working capital management.
what_to_watch: Subsequent RBI FX intervention data in the Weekly Statistical Supplement to observe actual dollar sales or purchases.
Foreign exchange reserve levels and movement trends in upcoming central bank releases.
ai_insight.evergreen_lesson: Central banks manage market friction and speculative excess rather than setting absolute asset prices.

ai_insight.why_it_matters: State governments auctioning securities to raise funds reflects sub-sovereign borrowing needs, which directly impact the supply dynamics of the domestic debt market. If investor demand fails to match the notified amounts, yields could face upward pressure. Such auctions indicate how fiscal deficits at the state level are continually financed through market borrowings.
what_to_watch: Bid-to-offer ratios for individual state stocks on the E-Kuber system
Cut-off yields and prices determined during the auction results
ai_insight.evergreen_lesson: Sub-sovereign debt supply directly influences local yield curves, meaning state-level fiscal deficits carry distinct pricing implications separate from central government borrowing.

stories.headline: RBI Bulletin – October 2026
stories.summary: Today, the Reserve Bank released the October 2026 issue of its monthly Bulletin. The Bulletin includes two speeches, four articles and current statistics. The four articles are: I. State of the Economy ; II. Transmission to Lending Rates of SCBs: Price versus Composition Effects in WALR ; III. Performance of the NBFC Sector: Review for 2025 ; and IV. Nowcasting State-Level Economic Activity in India with Night-Time Light and Google Trends . I. State of the Economy Renewed geopolitical frictions in West Asia and supply chain disruptions have amplified inflationary pressures, prompting major central banks to raise policy rates. Elevated sovereign bond yields in advanced economies (AEs) have also brought into focus concerns about fiscal sustainability and its implications for financial stability. The Indian economy continued to demonstrate strength as evidenced by high-frequency indicators

ai_insight.why_it_matters: The monthly bulletin aggregates high-frequency data and analytical studies, offering visibility into macroeconomic resilience and monetary transmission mechanisms. Discrepancies between policy rate cuts and actual lending rate adjustments would imply structural frictions in how commercial banks reprice credit. Tracking these trends helps gauge broader credit growth and inflationary pressures.
what_to_watch: Movements in the weighted average lending rate (WALR) on fresh loans relative to policy rate changes
Credit growth trajectories and bank borrowing shares within the non-banking financial company sector
ai_insight.evergreen_lesson: Monetary policy transmission is rarely uniform, as shifts in credit composition and bank-level asset pricing dictate the actual speed at which rate changes reach borrowers.

stories.headline: RBI issues Reserve Bank of India (Commercial Banks – Forthcoming Instructions) Second Amendment Directions, 2026 on Minimum Capital Requirements for Operational Risk
stories.summary: The Reserve Bank of India had issued Reserve Bank of India (Commercial Banks – Forthcoming Instructions) Directions, 2025 on November 28, 2025 . 2. Chapter IV of these Directions prescribed the Minimum Capital Requirements for Operational Risk, wherein it was specified that the effective date of implementation and indicative mapping of the components of the Business Indicator (BI) to the schedules and line items of the financial statements shall be provided in due course. Subsequently, Governor in his Statement dated October 01, 2025 , announced that the revised Basel III capital adequacy framework for Commercial Banks (excluding Small Finance Banks (SFBs), Payment Banks (PBs), Regional Rural Banks(RRBs)) would come into effect from April 01, 2027. Further, post issuance of these Directions, certain additional clarifications have been issued by the Basel Committee on Banking Supervision.

ai_insight.why_it_matters: Updating regulatory frameworks for operational risk capital requirements alters how commercial banks calculate capital adequacy, potentially affecting their lending capacity. If capital buffers must expand significantly under the standardized approach, banks might reallocate capital away from riskier business segments. This implementation directly ties regulatory compliance timelines to balance sheet planning.
what_to_watch: Commercial bank disclosures regarding capital adequacy ratios ahead of the effective date
Mapping of business indicator components to financial statement schedules by individual banks
ai_insight.evergreen_lesson: Regulatory changes in risk-weighting and capital requirements redefine baseline lending capacities, making compliance timelines critical inputs for asset growth.

The compounding of contraventions related to certain categories of transactions related to foreign direct inve

ai_insight.why_it_matters: Delegating the compounding of specific FEMA contraventions to regional offices decentralizes administrative enforcement, which can speed up the resolution of procedural violations for businesses. If regional offices efficiently process these applications, corporate compliance friction for cross-border investments could decrease. However, decentralization also requires consistent application of rules across different regional centers.
what_to_watch: Processing timelines for compounding applications submitted to designated regional offices
Volume of cases handled by regional offices versus the central office cell
ai_insight.evergreen_lesson: Administrative decentralization of regulatory enforcement reduces compliance friction only when regional operational capacity matches the volume of delegated applications.

stories.headline: RBI issues guidelines on the implementation of Leverage Ratio 2017 Standard
stories.summary: The Reserve Bank of India had issued the draft Reserve Bank of India (Commercial Banks – Prudential Norms on Capital Adequacy) Eleventh Amendment Directions, 2026 on August 7, 2026 , inviting feedback from stakeholders until August 28, 2026. The draft Amendment Directions proposed to implement the latest leverage ratio framework ('Leverage Ratio 2017 Standard') issued by the Basel Committee on Banking Supervision. 2. Feedback received on the draft Directions has been examined and consequent modifications have been suitably incorporated in the final Amendment Directions. The statement on the feedback received on the draft Directions is provided in the Annex . 3. Accordingly, the Reserve Bank has today released the Reserve Bank of India (Commercial Banks – Prudential Norms on Capital Adequacy) Eleventh Amendment Directions, 2026 . 4. These instructions will come into effect from April 1, 2

ai_insight.why_it_matters: The formal notification of Basel-aligned prudential norms institutionalizes stricter capital adequacy standards for commercial banks, shifting focus from risk-weighted assets to unweighted leverage constraints. If banks face tighter leverage ceilings, lending growth in low-margin, high-exposure segments could moderate as institutions preserve capital buffers. However, the lead time before implementation means actual balance sheet adjustments would occur gradually rather than immediately.
what_to_watch: Bank disclosures and compliance reports ahead of the April 1, 2027 effective date.
Tier 1 capital ratios and leverage ratio computations in individual bank financial statements.
ai_insight.evergreen_lesson: Regulatory capital frameworks constrain unconstrained balance sheet expansion by capping exposures relative to tier-1 capital.

stories.headline: Reserve Bank of India (Commercial Banks – Prudential Norms on Capital Adequacy) Eleventh Amendment Directions, 2026
stories.summary: RBI/2026-27/297 DOR.CAP.REC.251/21-02-002/2026-27 October 23, 2026 Reserve Bank of India (Commercial Banks – Prudential Norms on Capital Adequacy) Eleventh Amendment Directions, 2026 Please refer to 'Chapter VII: Leverage Ratio framework' of the Reserve Bank of India (Commercial Banks – Prudential Norms on Capital Adequacy) Directions, 2025 (hereinafter referred to as 'the Directions'). To ensure alignment with the latest leverage ratio framework ('leverage ratio 2017 standard') issued by the Basel Committee on Banking Supervision, there is a felt need to amend these Directions. 2. Accordingly, in exercise of the powers conferred by Section 35A of the Banking Regulation Act, 1949 and all other provisions / laws enabling the Reserve Bank of India to issue instructions in this regard, the Reserve Bank being satisfied that it is necessary and expedient in the public interest so to do, hereb

ai_insight.why_it_matters: Codifying specific leverage ratio minimums and capital distribution constraints for domestic and global systemically important banks establishes hard guardrails against excessive balance sheet leverage. If a G-SIB branch breaches its combined buffer requirements, mandatory capital distribution constraints would restrict profit repatriation or dividend payouts. However, the rule itself only defines the penalty structure; its actual impact depends on whether individual institutions operate close to these regulatory thresholds.
what_to_watch: Disclosures by G-SIB branches in India regarding their leverage ratio buffers and CET1 ratios.
Official circulars or clarifications on capital conservation standard enforcements.
ai_insight.evergreen_lesson: Systemically important financial institutions operate under dual constraints where leverage limits reinforce risk-weighted capital rules.

stories.headline: China stocks sink deeper into bear market despite state buying
stories.summary: Chinese stocks sank deeper into a bear market on Friday as state-backed rescue efforts failed to restore investor confidence, with the CSI 300 Index sliding further amid persistent momentum issues.

ai_insight.why_it_matters: Jab market mein sentiment negative hota hai, toh sirf state-backed buying ya low valuations (jaise 4,000 ka level ya ETF inflows) confidence wapas laane ke liye kaafi nahi hoti. Jab tak corporate earnings growth ya market momentum improve nahi hota, tab tak investors valuations ko dekh kar fresh capital deploy karne se bach sakte hain. Iska matlab yeh hai ki policy support ya capital infusion ke baad bhi market mein sustained recovery tab tak mushkil ho sakti hai jab tak underlying economic fundamentals turn around na karein.
what_to_watch: CSI 300 Index aur Hong Kong tech gauge ke weekly price movements aur trading volumes mein stabilization
State-backed ETF inflows ke figures aur subsequent months mein institutional participation ka data
ai_insight.evergreen_lesson: Cheap valuations alone do not act as a market catalyst; recovery requires concurrent improvements in fundamental growth and investor momentum.

stories.headline: Stock Crash: Australian company shares tank 50% after flagging $7.1 million US fraud
stories.summary: Zip Co. shares fell up to 50% after disclosing A$10.1 million in fraud-related costs in the United States, prompting concerns about transparency and onboarding.

ai_insight.why_it_matters: Jab ek foreign market se major revenue aane wali company ke andar sudden fraud ya cyber breach ka disclosure hota hai, toh market confidence jaldi girta hai kyunki yeh onboarding systems aur risk controls par सवाल khada karta hai. Jabki source ne sirf fraudulent account creation aur A$10.1 million ke costs report kiye hain, agar yeh vulnerabilities deep-seated niklein, toh international expansion models ki scalability aur compliance costs par bada asar pad sakta hai. Yeh incident yeh establish nahi karta ki pura business model fail ho gaya hai, balki yeh dikhata hai ki fast growth ke chakkar mein risk management compromise ho sakta hai.
what_to_watch: Quarterly net credit losses aur badhte fraud costs ka trend US market mein.
Management changes aur interim US CEO ke under risk-mitigation aur onboarding controls ka implementation.
Official disclosures regarding recovery of funds ya future technology upgrades.
ai_insight.evergreen_lesson: Fast-growing digital platforms that rely heavily on automated onboarding in overseas markets are vulnerable to sophisticated fraud, which can quickly erode valuation if internal control mechanisms fail to scale alongside transaction volumes.
